items.q: AI 安全事件引发的芯片抛售，是一次性冲击还是趋势起点？
items.q_en: Is the AI-safety chip selloff a one-off shock or the start of a trend?
items.expect: 若只是情绪冲击，美股 CPO 成员（12 只）等权在 10/5 收盘前收复 9/28 的跌幅。
items.expect_en: If it is a sentiment shock, the 12 US CPO members recover their 9/28 equal-weighted loss by the 10/5 close.
items.falsifier: 10/5 收盘时，美股 CPO 等权相对 9/25 收盘仍为负。
items.falsifier_en: At the 10/5 close the US CPO equal-weighted return versus the 9/25 close is still negative.
items.now: 9/28 美股 CPO 大跌，SOX 约 -2%

items.q: 10 年期美债站上 5.2% 后，黄金会否在周五非农前继续承压？
items.q_en: With the 10-year above 5.2%, will gold stay under pressure into Friday's payrolls?
items.expect: 只要 10 年期维持在 5.2% 以上，黄金期货 10/2 收盘低于 9/28 收盘（4,154.7）。
items.expect_en: As long as the 10-year stays above 5.2%, gold futures close below the 9/28 close (4,154.7) on 10/2.
items.falsifier: 10 年期仍在 5.2% 以上，但黄金 10/2 收盘高于 4,154.7。
items.falsifier_en: The 10-year is still above 5.2% but gold closes above 4,154.7 on 10/2.

items.q: 英国首购计划的涨幅，能否撑到预算公布细节之前？
items.q_en: Will the UK first-home rally hold until the Budget details?
items.expect: 五大建房商（Persimmon、Barratt Redrow、Taylor Wimpey、Vistry、Bellway）10/9 收盘时，相对 9/25 收盘等权仍高于 +8%。
items.expect_en: The big five housebuilders stay more than +8% above their 9/25 closes, equal-weighted, at the 10/9 close.
items.falsifier: 10/9 收盘时等权涨幅回落到 +5% 以下。
items.falsifier_en: By the 10/9 close the equal-weighted gain has fallen below +5%.

items.q: A股光模块会否在国庆休市前继续下跌？
items.q_en: Will A-share optical names keep falling before the National Day break?
items.expect: 4 只 A股 CPO 成员 9/29–9/30 两日累计等权收益为负。
items.expect_en: The four A-share CPO members' cumulative EW return over 9/29–9/30 is negative.
items.falsifier: 两日累计等权收益为正。
items.falsifier_en: The two-day cumulative EW return is positive.
